body:
Me and my friend 'J' wanted to eat shrooms for our 1st time.but we were in for more then we had thought.
We got a quarter Ounce of some great looking shrooms.we ate them with a Fanta. About 12 minutes into it something weird had hit me, and we were in my friends ('S') bathroom and I felt the urge to get out of the house. This knowingly, was very uncommon for most shroomers to digest. Fear came upon me and we finaly left. We were walking into a park with small trees everywhere and everything smiled, and and morphed into objects that cannot be explained,and all of a sudden I started laughing as hard as I could from the trip,and realized my friends were way ahead of me and sprinted to them, we got to a local baseball field and turned into an amusement park of beauty. Everything beautiful,as I also looked at what it looked to be about 100 airplanes in the sky, and Extreme Time dialation. To give an example of this, my friend also on shrooms was kicking a garbage can and I looked away and looked backing thinking I had turned away for 1 second,and he was 100 feet further. Later on we got back to house and my friend had a bad reaction to a bad enviroment, a small room, and it got the best of him. He started puking and forced him into the bathroom,and this is where the bad trip had started. As I looked at him throw up and to my mind he was filling the complete bathroom with thrown-up shrooms and fanta, finaly our friend S gave him 1m of Ativan(a benzo), and 5 minutes later he came back to reality and he was on a good trip again. For what I thought this 30 minute bad trip was,it was actually only 3 minutes.
For the next hour we came down,still hallucinating,but finaly chilled to a euphoric state.
